name: ComCcsds.comQueue.FLUSH_QUEUE
annotation: Flush a specific queue. This will discard all queued data in the specified queue removing it from eventual downlink. Buffers requiring ownership return will be returned via the bufferReturnOut port.

name: ComCcsds.comQueue.FLUSH_ALL_QUEUES
annotation: Flush all queues. This will discard all queued data removing it from eventual downlink. Buffers requiring ownership return will be returned via the bufferReturnOut port.

name: ComCcsds.comQueue.SET_QUEUE_PRIORITY
annotation: Set the priority of a specific queue at runtime

name: ComCcsds.comQueue.QueuePriorityChanged

name: ComCcsds.fprimeRouter.FileOutContextTableFull
format: Buffer-to-context table full on fileOut; context will be lost for this buffer
annotation: The buffer-to-context table was full when a buffer was handed off on fileOut. The buffer is still forwarded, but its context cannot be restored on return and will be returned empty.

name: ComCcsds.fprimeRouter.BufferContextNotFound
format: Returned buffer not found in context table; returning with empty context
annotation: A buffer returned on fileBufferReturnIn was not found in the buffer-to-context table. The buffer is still returned, but with an empty context.
